articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.snippet: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
articles.snippet: BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.

articles.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre
articles.snippet: The court injunctions apply strictly to users within the AIFC and do not extend across the rest of Kazakhstan.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs join objections to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading
articles.snippet: Seven more issuers have opted out of being listed on the planned tokenized stock venue under the SEC's framework, bringing its disclosed objection count to 16.
